MASTER FILTER
One filter drives assets, complaints, technician visits, transfers, approvals, Machine 360, reports, labels and control views. LIFE business month runs from the 6th to the 5th.

Asset Command Centre

A print-ready management view built only from live ERPNext records visible to the logged-in user.

Asset Register

Every Asset record currently visible to the logged-in ERPNext user.

Check Desk

Technicians & Visits

Live Asset Maintenance Log records, assigned persons, due dates, completion dates and visit actions.

Complaints

Transfer & Shifting

Live issue, receipt, transfer, and transfer-and-issue records from ERPNext Asset Movement.

Depreciation

Current asset value, depreciation position, next posting date, and Asset Depreciation Schedule records.

Machine 360

One machine’s real master data, finance, maintenance, complaints, movements, and activity history.

Reports

Live summaries generated from the currently filtered records. Every report can be exported to CSV.

Approvals Desk

Real pending documents derived from draft Asset Movements, open Issue complaints, and pending Asset Maintenance Logs.

Asset Label Printing

Print labels from the currently filtered live Asset records.

Masters & Control Panel

PDF-style master position built from live Asset, Supplier, Branch and permitted operational DocTypes—without seeded machine, vendor, role or threshold data.
